feature: Create title automatic focus and selection
behavior: Create claims the keyboard within the mobile opening gesture and transfers focus to Title after mount, selecting the default name.
Switching to Draft synchronously commits the new title then focuses and selects it in the same gesture, without another Title tap.
Variant switch cancels pending opening focus so it cannot select an edited Draft later.
Previously edited Draft titles are not forcibly selected on re-focus.

firefox.focus_check: Selecting Draft focuses and selects the generated name on actual Desktop and touch branches without manually focusing Title.

limits: Browser DOM focus/selection tests do not prove the physical iOS software keyboard behavior.
No shared composer editor implementation changed.
